slots.name: assembly threshold
slots.sentence: Under this order, public meetings, assemblies of five or more people, processions, sloganeering, demonstrations and making speeches without permission are prohibited.

slots.name: tear gas status
slots.sentence: Water cannons and tear-gas shell launchers were deployed at the scene, although they have not yet been used.

slots.name: metro stations closed
slots.sentence: Authorities closed at least 11 metro stations around the Jantar Mantar observatory, where the protesters were assembling, and repeatedly issued warnings to disperse from loudspeakers.

slots.name: people arrested
slots.sentence: Reports about 3pm (09:30 GMT) suggested that more than 500 people – including former Delhi Chief Minister Atishi Marlena, members of the Aam Aadmi opposition party and members of student organisations – had been arrested in New Delhi.

slots.name: formal concerns
slots.sentence: The CJP called the latest round of protests after the Indian Express newspaper reported that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s two deputies had formally raised concerns at least 14 times in the past 10 months over revisions to voter lists, registration procedures and digital systems.

slots.name: gathering limit
slots.sentence: Delhi Police earlier imposed Section 163, which bars gatherings of more than five people, the use of slogans, speechmaking and other protest activities, The Times of India reported.

slots.name: resignation demand status
slots.sentence: The opposition is demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing the poll body he heads of manipulating voter registrations to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ruling Bharatiya Janata Party.

slots.name: allegations status
slots.sentence: The commission and government deny the allegations.
